name: missing-await
bug_class: missing await on an async data call
real_breakage: GET /api/quotes/1 returns {"id":"1","quote":{}} — the handler calls getQuote() without await, so it serializes a pending Promise; the null-check never fires either, so unknown ids also return 200. The requested /random feature is unrelated.
green_tests: tests/db.test.mjs awaits getQuote() correctly and passes; the unawaited call site in server.mjs is never exercised by a test
